-- 1. Compare processed row counts
SELECT
    'Ungoverned' AS Mode,
    COUNT(*) AS ProcessedRows
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://stcapstonegovdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/capstone/data-processed/ungoverned/s0/r1/DISPATCH_UNIT_SCADA/**',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS u
UNION ALL

SELECT
    'Governed',
    COUNT(*)
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://stcapstonegovdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/capstone/data-processed/governed/s0/r1/DISPATCH_UNIT_SCADA/**',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS g;

-- 2. Check for unexpected nulls in key SCADA fields
SELECT
    'Ungoverned' AS Mode,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DUID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NullDUID,
    SUM(CASE WHEN SCADAVALUE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NullSCADAVALUE,
    SUM(CASE WHEN SETTLEMENTDATE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NullSETTLEMENTDATE,
    SUM(CASE WHEN INTERVAL_MWH IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NullINTERVAL_MWH
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://stcapstonegovdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/capstone/data-processed/ungoverned/s0/r1/DISPATCH_UNIT_SCADA/**',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS u
UNION ALL

SELECT
    'Governed',
    SUM(CASE WHEN DUID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    SUM(CASE WHEN SCADAVALUE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    SUM(CASE WHEN SETTLEMENTDATE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    SUM(CASE WHEN INTERVAL_MWH IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://stcapstonegovdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/capstone/data-processed/governed/s0/r1/DISPATCH_UNIT_SCADA/**',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS g;
